consumer: The frontend's monster HP-bar renderer, which asks 'what color (green/yellow/red bracket) does the GUI paint this monster's HP bar?' — i.e. the engine's own display formatting of the HP ratio into a color bucket.
scope: The GUI's per-monster displayed HP-bar color/bracket as the engine would render it (the formatted, bucketed view), not the raw hp integers behind it.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters), which writes mon.get_hp()/get_hp_max() raw integers — raw simulation state (class S), leaving the engine's color-bucketing/get_hp_bar formatting unreproduced.
divergence: A monster whose engine-rendered HP-bar color comes from the engine's own bucketing rules (e.g. a hallucination or a creature whose get_hp_bar thresholds round the displayed bracket differently than a naive frontend hp/hp_max ratio) — the raw integers yield a color that disagrees with the color the GUI would actually display.
